title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.97 (versions follow prime numbers) does the four things 0.89 left asked for and undone. The heart (tissue 7): a cell passes through its gear the share of time the kernel gives the cabin that says it, and asks the kernel for it; the kernel cuts it down to what the cabin was launched with (its law: nobody gives itself more than it was given), and is asked only when the turn changes. A tissue she opens herself (tissue 8): a cell says its own place with four more letters, any word of her reader's memory; no list of places is kept, the place is in the recipe. Such a reading is the only one she cages, with what all her finished readings together have rowed, so no number is set by hand. Foreign code: all the code she has is taken apart together into gears with one rule (a jump-free piece that repeats, said once, saves): her own body, KolibriOS assembler, C, Lua and the kernel's machine code. And she ate all the free code: her shelf went from 4.66 to 10.03 MB. Measured: with everything served her best recipe reads 93142 bits (23611 with the previous shelf) and each reading takes about five times longer; a heart cell leaves the score unchanged and can only slow her; of the places tried by hand none improves the champion and two break the reader without touching her. Stated limits: no cell or song of hers has won yet; taking code apart is still done by Python when she is built. A bug of 0.83 is fixed (gears loading a constant above 15 were silently left out of her table). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.97: el corazón (el turno que da el núcleo, por un engranaje), un tejido que abre ella (cualquier lugar de su lectora, dicho por la célula), engranajes de todo el código que tiene y todo el código libre servido. Prototipo de investigación.
